name: hktrpg
description: Sad's HKTRPG is a TRPG dice rolling bot for Telegram, Line, Whatsapp, web site, plurk and Discord. 現支援TRPG暗骰, TPRG擲骰, 頻道經驗值, 占卜, 先攻表, TRPG角色卡, 搜圖, 翻譯, Discord 聊天紀錄匯出, 數學計算, 做筆記, 隨機抽選, 自定抽選, 定時發送
